note: Static snapshot. Runtime tools/list remains authoritative when the MCP server is running.

tools.name: autoshop_bootstrap
tools.description: Read-only orientation for supported AutoShop workflows, beginner explanations, project health checks, snapshots, and live communication options.

tools.name: autoshop_detect_open_instances
tools.description: Detect running AutoShop windows and parse project path, active block, version, process path, foreground status, and selected default instance.

tools.name: autoshop_explain_project_for_beginner
tools.description: Explain the selected AutoShop project for a PLC beginner: where to start, MAIN calls, program areas, variable hints, glossary, and next questions.

tools.name: autoshop_explain_block_for_beginner
tools.description: Explain one AutoShop block for a PLC beginner: block role, LD/ST/FB meaning, CALLs, common instructions, symbols, and next steps.

tools.name: autoshop_scan_active_project
tools.description: Scan the selected open AutoShop project and read communication settings such as configured PLC IP.

tools.name: autoshop_run_capability_self_test
tools.description: Read-only readiness check for AutoShop process detection, selected project scan, install files, communication config, and instruction catalog.

tools.name: autoshop_list_instruction_catalog
tools.description: List and filter instructions from AutoShop AIAssistantELinkCmd.xml.

tools.name: autoshop_analyze_call_graph
tools.description: Build a best-effort CALL graph across AutoShop blocks and resolve called block files.

tools.name: autoshop_inspect_project_health
tools.description: Inspect project health, including project files, folder.txt alignment, CALL graph, communication config, variable tables, orphan blocks, and largest blocks.

tools.name: autoshop_export_project_snapshot
tools.description: Export JSON and Markdown project snapshots containing health checks and project summary data.

tools.name: autoshop_validate_point_table
tools.description: Validate JSON or CSV point tables for naming, duplicate addresses, Modbus areas, and data types.

tools.name: autoshop_scan_project
tools.description: Read an AutoShop project directory and summarize blocks, variable tables, project files, config files, and folder.txt index.

tools.name: autoshop_list_program_blocks
tools.description: List LD, ST, and FB block files with pagination and language filtering. Defaults to the selected open AutoShop project when projectPath is omitted.

tools.name: autoshop_read_block_source
tools.description: Read ST text blocks or summarize LD/FB binary containers by extracting readable calls, instructions, comments, and symbols.

tools.name: autoshop_search_symbols
tools.description: Search blocks, variable tables, and config files for symbols, addresses, instructions, and comments.

tools.name: autoshop_parse_variable_tables
tools.description: Extract readable variable records from .gdt, .gvt, .csv, .fbi, .eipgvt, and .ecgvt files.

tools.name: autoshop_generate_ladder
tools.description: Generate ASCII ladder review material and equivalent ST from structured rung JSON.

tools.name: autoshop_generate_st_source
tools.description: Generate Structured Text source from templates or explicit operation lists, with optional file output.

tools.name: autoshop_scaffold_project_bundle
tools.description: Generate an AutoShop engineering bundle with ST, ladder review files, point tables, manifest, and import notes.

tools.name: autoshop_read_live_points
tools.description: Read live points from an Inovance PLC over Modbus TCP.

tools.name: autoshop_write_live_points
tools.description: Write live points to an Inovance PLC over Modbus TCP. Requires confirmRisk=true.

tools.name: autoshop_monitor_live_points
tools.description: Poll live points over Modbus TCP and return timestamped samples.
